## Use Berkeley Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Berkeley Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Berkeley Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Berkeley Mono coding font

Designed at UC Berkeley, modern and clean. Berkeley Mono is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Berkeley Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## Berkeley Mono FAQ

### Is Berkeley Mono free?

No. Berkeley Mono is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Berkeley Mono support ligatures?

No. Berkeley Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Berkeley Mono?

Berkeley Mono is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
